DIAGNOSIS READY: Risperidone-induced acute dystonia.

The combination of new risperidone use two months ago, normal metabolic workup, and the exclusion of other movement patterns strongly points to a medication-induced extrapyramidal side effect. We should consider adjusting the antipsychotic regimen or adding an anticholinergic agent to resolve the symptoms.
